result.description: Twilio SendGrid: cloud email delivery for transactional and marketing email, with contacts, templates, campaigns and stats APIs.
result.auth_detail: API keys (scoped permissions) sent as Bearer token in the Authorization header. No OAuth2 for the public v3 API (OAuth only for partner/Mail partner integrations).
result.access_detail: Pricing page offers a free trial with no credit card; the permanent free tier has been retired, so continued API use needs a paid plan after the trial. Sending also needs sender/domain verification.
result.api_notes: v3 Web API REST: mail send, contacts/lists/segments, marketing campaigns/singlesends, templates, suppressions, stats, API keys, subusers, domain auth, webhooks. SDKs in seven languages.
result.blocker: No permanent free tier: trial-only self-serve, then paid plan. Auth is API key only (user-supplied, no OAuth). No official vendor MCP found.

evidence.quote: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.
Ensure secure, controllable account access with API keys.
Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required.
The SendGrid API endpoints allow you to integrate with your tech stack to send transactional emails, create marketing campaigns, manage your contacts, and monitor the health of your email statistics.
Sendgrid MCP, Contacts, Templates, Campaigns, Stats, etc. more to come. With READ_ONLY option.
